children: Garrett Mark, a Director, reported a direct sale of 50,000 shares of common stock on September 4, 2026 at $350.00 per share. The transaction generated total proceeds of $17,500,000. After the reported sale, Garrett Mark directly owns 10,074 shares and indirectly owns 121,010 shares held in four trusts for his children. The report notes that the direct holdings include shares to be issued upon vesting of restricted stock units and that the indirect holdings are held in irrevocable trusts for beneficiaries Lee A. Garrett and Brittany R.G. Smith.
